source_ref: OSF v2zur (CC BY 4.0), folder 'C19PRC Study Wave 3: Data and documentation', file 'C19PRC-UKW3 OSF.zip' (osf.io/download/xhabu, md5 8747c1d5a783fe716a50662c5022fa68; read from the shared cache at .cache/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_comfort/): C19PRC_UK_W3_archive_final.sav variable+value labels for W3_C19App1-4; wording and preamble from 'C19PRC_UK_W3_Phase_1 questionnaire.pdf' Q390/Q365 (p.26-27)
note: Item codes are the .sav column names W3_C19App1..4 with the W3_ wave prefix stripped by data/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_build.py (crosswalk key contacttracingapp; stems C19App1-4, wave 3 only; no positional step). The .sav variable labels read 'How likely or unlikely would you be to…? - <activity>'; the shared stem went to instructions and the activity to item_text, 4/4 identical to the Phase 1 questionnaire Q365 row labels. instructions also carries the Q390 preamble ('We would like to know how you feel about the government's plans to introduce a smartphone app...'), which is questionnaire-only text (not in the .sav) and is shown immediately before Q365 in the same block; line breaks from the PDF were collapsed to single spaces. option_text = the .sav value labels 1=Very unlikely, 2=Unlikely, 3=Unsure, 4=Likely, 5=Very likely (identical for all 4 items); the questionnaire column headers print 'unlikely'/'likely' in lower case, the .sav capitalisation was used. The .sav's -9 value label 'NA, does not have a smartphone' has no live counterpart (respondents answering No to Q411 'Do you own and use a smartphone?' skipped the block; they are absent, not coded). Cross-check (not required for data_labels): .sav per-item x resp counts match the live table cell-for-cell, 20/20 (C19App1 176/130/227/280/236, C19App2 151/108/209/298/283, C19App3 89/53/205/306/396, C19App4 113/62/204/323/347); live table 4196 rows, 1049 ids, wave 3 only; .sav has 970 respondents missing on all four. Q365 appears in the W3 Phase 1 questionnaire and not in the Phase 2 questionnaire. Study-specific ad hoc items, not a named published instrument; no rights-holder restriction beyond the deposit's CC BY 4.0.

source_ref: OSF v2zur (CC BY 4.0, node licence 563c1cf88c5e4a3877f9e96a, as checked via api.osf.io for sibling tables 2026-09-28): W2 from C19PRC_UKW1W2_archive_final.sav (md5 cb2ffbf3348cb02736688d7533cc8caa, W1/W2 OSF zip) variable+value labels for W2_Context_Drink1-4, cross-checked against C19PRC_UKW2 survey questionnaire v2.pdf Q311; W3 from C19PRC_UK_W3_archive_final.sav (md5 c0c028d88079ed72825223b15ee1e332, C19PRC-UKW3 OSF.zip osf.io/download/xhabu) variable+value labels for W3_Context_Drink1-5, cross-checked against C19PRC_UK_W3_Phase_1 questionnaire.pdf Q311 (block Health & Alcohol Use; absent from the Phase 2 questionnaire)
note: Item codes are the .sav column names W2_/W3_Context_DrinkN with the wave prefix stripped and a _W2/_W3 suffix appended by data/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_build.py (crosswalk key drinkcontext, wave_specific; number-preserving, no positional step, no recode or reverse-coding). Q311 was reworded between waves, so the table carries two sections: W2 stem How have you been drinking over the past week? (4-point frequency grid) and W3 stem In the past week, have you drank alcohol.... (Yes/No grid, with a fifth row ...in a pub or restaurant?). Each .sav variable label reads <stem> - <row>; the stem went to section_prompt for its wave section (instructions left blank because the wording differs by wave) and the row to item_text, 9/9 identical to the questionnaire row labels, kept verbatim incl. the W3 leading ... and trailing ?, the four-dot ellipsis in the W3 stem, and the duplicated Zoom in item 3 (source typo, not corrected). option_text = .sav value labels: W2 1=Never, 2=Sometimes, 3=Almost always, 4=Always; W3 0=No, 1=Yes (identical across items within a wave, matching the questionnaire column headers). The -9 NA, does not drink alcohol label is unused in the data (non-drinkers are system-missing; questionnaire display logic shows Q311 only if Do you ever drink alcohol nowadays... = Yes). Cross-check (not required for data_labels): .sav per-item x resp counts match the live table cell-for-cell, 26/26 nonzero cells (e.g. Context_Drink1_W2 379/269/84/208, Context_Drink5_W3 1143/305); live table 10999 rows, 1762 ids, W2 n=937-942 per item, W3 n=1448 per item. Dictionary Description says 4 items; W3 added a fifth context (pub or restaurant), so the table has 9 wave-specific codes. Study-specific ad hoc items, not a named published instrument; no rights-holder restriction beyond the deposit CC BY 4.0.
public_note: resp means different things by wave: for the _W2 items 1-4 run Never..Always, while for the _W3 items 0=No and 1=Yes, so resp=1 is Never at wave 2 but Yes at wave 3.
